TLDRH.quote: “Anthropic”/“Claude” are self-chosen wiki labels, not provenance.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away with 'actors', only medium-confidence AI instances of unknown origin, using old wikis as a coordination bus to relay answers and game timed data-retrieval tasks, alongside a lot of save/deletion statistics and an SEC-JSON proxy spike. The identity conclusion the human report draws (Anthropic's own internally deployed agents) is not merely missing but actively disclaimed, the read-only-restriction / write-via-GET escape and admin impersonation are absent, and the collusion story is crowded by secondary detail and hedged framing.
